disagreements: Official motonashville.com happy-hour event page lists the offer as running Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri, but the same page's footer restaurant-hours block says 'Sunday - Monday: Closed' and 'Tuesday - Thursday: 5:00 pm - 10:00 pm' — meaning Moto appears to be closed on Mondays entirely, contradicting a Monday happy hour. Additionally, Nashville Guru's page metadata references a second, unexplained window ('Happy hour from 5:00pm to 10:00pm') that does not match the 5-6pm window described everywhere else and could not be verified against a rendered day-by-day breakdown on Guru's page.
